read.title: Listing Review: Collagen Mask
read.text:
Our collagen mask listing has strong traffic, but the conversion rate dropped to 9 percent last month. Customer reviews suggest that the main image does not show the product size clearly.

We recommend three changes. First, add a photo of the mask next to a hand for scale. Second, move the key benefit, "hydration for 24 hours," to the first bullet point. Third, mention that the mask is suitable for sensitive skin.

We will test the new listing for two weeks and compare the results.

write.en: Write three Amazon bullet points for a new moisturizing cream: key benefit, skin type, and how to use it.
write.model:
- 48-HOUR HYDRATION: Ceramides and hyaluronic acid lock in moisture all day without a greasy feel.
